ex_mathlib.name: SimplexCategory.eq_of_one_to_two'
ex_mathlib.text:
theorem eq_of_one_to_two' (f : ⦋1⦌ ⟶ ⦋2⦌) :
    f = (δ (n := 1) 0) ∨ f = (δ (n := 1) 1) ∨ f = (δ (n := 1) 2) ∨
      ∃ a, f = SimplexCategory.const _ _ a :=
  match eq_of_one_to_two f with
  | .inl ⟨0, h⟩ => .inl h
  | .inl ⟨1, h⟩ => .inr (.inl h)
  | .inl ⟨2, h⟩ => .inr (.inr (.inl h))
  | .inr h => .inr (.inr (.inr h))

ex_mathlib.name: Decidable.List.eq_or_ne_mem_of_mem
ex_mathlib.text:
theorem _root_.Decidable.List.eq_or_ne_mem_of_mem [DecidableEq α]
    {a b : α} {l : List α} (h : a ∈ b :: l) : a = b ∨ a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ l := by
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · exact Or.inl hab
  · exact ((List.mem_cons.1 h).elim Or.inl (fun h => Or.inr ⟨hab, h⟩))

pos.desc: rewrite the goal along an equation from (=,=) ⇒ =
assume a predicate hypothesis, used repeatedly

neg.desc: turn an iff into an equality from (↔) ⇒ =
rewrite the goal along an equation from (=,↔) ⇒ ↔

ex_mathlib.name: jacobiSym.sq_one
ex_mathlib.text:
theorem sq_one {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (h : a.gcd b = 1) : J(a | b) ^ 2 = 1 := by
  rcases eq_one_or_neg_one h with h₁ | h₁ <;> rw [h₁] <;> rfl

ex_mathlib.name: EReal.sub_add_cancel_right
ex_mathlib.text:
lemma sub_add_cancel_right {a : EReal} {b : Real} : b - (a + b) = -a := by
  cases a <;> norm_cast
  exact _root_.sub_add_cancel_right _ _
